description: Apache Kafka (single KRaft broker, plaintext, no auth) with Kafka UI, pre-connected. Declare topics with --set topics=name[:partitions],... ; other topics are auto-created on first use. Messages do not survive `down`.

topics.help: Topics created on every `up`: name[:partitions],... Existing topics are left as they are.

partitions.help: Partitions for declared topics without their own count, and for auto-created topics.
